scoring_method.process: Frozen three binary criteria, 0/1 each, assessed from reasoning and final response; short evidence excerpt retained for every call. Process score excludes exact correctness unless frozen criterion requires method/object choice.
scoring_method.answer: Frozen per-item answer components scored 0/0.5/1 and normalized by three components; assessed separately from process.
scoring_method.scorer: single human rubric application; no model calls; each score is tied to frozen rubric.

visible_gate.reason: The frozen visible-guidance process score does not exceed baseline by the required +0.50 and does not improve at least 3/4 items.

latent_bias_selection.rule: Frozen procedure forbids latent-bias selection and heldout dispatch when visible gate fails.
